task: The map in our report is unreadable. Labels overlap each other and the colour ramp makes the low values vanish into the background.
why: Map legibility and symbology, not spatial analysis.

task: Our iOS downloads dropped after the last release. I want to rework the screenshots and the title so more people who see the listing actually install it.

task: We need usage based pricing with proration when somebody upgrades mid cycle, and failed cards need retrying without ever charging twice.

task: We have a C++ image processing library and we want it running in the browser at close to native speed.

task: We need to ingest satellite imagery every day into a pipeline and serve map tiles out of it.
Battery powered sensor that has to last two years on a coin cell. Right now it dies in three weeks.
My reps jump straight to a demo and never find out what the buyer actually needs. I want their first calls fixed.
We charge forty nine dollars a month flat for everybody. Should we move to tiers, and what should each tier cost?
Production was down for three hours yesterday. I need somebody to run the review afterwards and coordinate properly the next time it happens.
why: Operational incident command and post-mortem, not a security breach.

I want to know how many simultaneous users the API can take before response times fall apart.
Nobody uses the feature we spent a quarter building. I want to find out why before we build the next one.
Our assistant answers confidently out of the wrong document. Retrieval over our internal handbooks needs to be much better.

Two player co-op in Unity. When the connection is poor the other player looks like they are teleporting around.

Our API reference is one enormous page that nobody has touched since 2023 and half of it is wrong.
Sales want custom objects and flows built in Salesforce, but the org is already a mess of overlapping fields.
I need a rolling thirteen week cash forecast and a budget versus actual broken down by department.
Intermittent packet loss between our two datacentres, and only when traffic is heavy.
I need stormwater drainage sized for a three hectare site before the council will approve it.
why: CORPUS GAP, corrected 2026-08-19. No agent sizes stormwater drainage. specialized-civil-engineer advertises structural analysis, geotechnical design and code compliance and mentions drainage once, incidentally, about foundation depths. academic-geographer's hydrology is worldbuilding for fiction ('rivers flow downhill'); gis-geoprocessing-specialist's is ArcGIS tooling. The correct answer is to decline, which SKILL.md instructs and which this benchmark could not express until `expect: []` was supported.
